programme.desc: The Southerner (Gene Tierney) and her husband (Randolph Scott) are still fighting the Civil War, chased by a Union major (Dana Andrews) smitten with Belle.

programme.title: Stagecoach
programme.desc: An outlaw (John Wayne), a prostitute (Claire Trevor), a drunken doctor and assorted others go through Indian country.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Americans (Mark Stevens, Patric Knowles) try to smuggle gold from France to use against the British in the War of 1812.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Americans (Mark Stevens, Patric Knowles) try to smuggle gold from France to use against the British in the War of 1812.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: The outlaw (Wendell Corey) tries to kill an insurance agent (Bob Hope) who has been mistaken for him in order to collect on a big policy.

programme.title: Hercules and the Captive Women
programme.desc: The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).

programme.title: What's Up, Doc?
programme.desc: A music professor (Ryan O'Neal) visits San Francisco with his fiancée (Madeline Kahn) and meets a kooky woman (Barbra Streisand).

programme.title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: A time-warped astronaut (James Franciscus) lands on ape-ruled Earth and finds telepathic mutants worshiping an atomic bomb.

programme.title: Pride and Prejudice
programme.desc: The arrival of wealthy bachelors in town causes an uproar when families with single daughters aggressively seek engagements, including the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: A suave stranger (Cary Grant) helps a chic widow (Audrey Hepburn) stalked by four men looking for loot in Paris.

programme.title: Artists and Models
programme.desc: A cartoonist (Dean Martin) turns his babbling roommate's (Jerry Lewis) bizarre dreams into a hit comic strip read by spies.

programme.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
programme.desc: New York playgirl Holly Golightly puzzles a writer who lives in her building.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: People pester an old, dying gunfighter (John Wayne) rooming with a widow (Lauren Bacall) in 1901 Nevada.

programme.title: The Big Wheel
programme.desc: Banned from racing, a brash young driver (Mickey Rooney) returns to Indianapolis and burns up the track.

programme.title: Son of Dracula
programme.desc: Count Alucard comes out of a lake in his coffin and makes a Southern belle his bride.

programme.title: 49th Parallel
programme.desc: A U-boat Nazi (Eric Portman) and his comrades raid a Canadian outpost, hijack a seaplane and kill to reach the United States.

programme.title: The Stork Club
programme.desc: An eccentric old New York millionaire anonymously repays a hatcheck girl for saving his life.
